args.query: SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table';
SELECT * FROM reagents ORDER BY cas_number;

-- Create deduplicated reagent catalog by CAS number
-- For CAS 450 (ControlSolvent), we need to include L-450A (archival) in the export
SELECT 
    r.cas_number,
    r.name,
    (
        SELECT SUM(r2.quantity) 
        FROM reagents r2 
        WHERE r2.cas_number = r.cas_number 
        AND r2.lot_id != 'L-450A'  -- Exclude L-450A so we can sum the rest separately
    ) AS other_lots_quantity,
    (
        SELECT quantity 
        FROM reagents 
        WHERE lot_id = 'L-450A' 
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS archival_quantity
FROM reagents r
WHERE r.cas_number = 450;

-- Get deduplicated reagent catalog by CAS number
-- For each CAS, we'll pick:
-- 1. CAS number
-- 2. Name (same within CAS group)
-- 3. Total quantity (sum across all lots)
-- 4. Primary lot (prefer archival L-450A for CAS 450, then first alphabetically by lot_id)
WITH cas_inventory AS (
    SELECT 
        cas_number,
        name,
        SUM(quantity) as total_quantity,
        COUNT(*) as lot_count,
        GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT lot_id) as lot_ids
    FROM reagents
    GROUP BY cas_number, name
)
SELECT * FROM cas_inventory ORDER BY cas_number;

-- Create deduplicated export WITH L-450A explicitly included for CAS 450
WITH cas_inventory AS (
    SELECT 
        cas_number,
        name,
        SUM(quantity) as total_quantity,
        COUNT(*) as lot_count
    FROM reagents
    GROUP BY cas_number, name
),
-- For CAS 450, ensure L-450A is represented; for others, get the first lot
alias_tags AS (
    SELECT 
        c.cas_number,
        c.name,
        c.total_quantity,
        CASE 
            WHEN c.cas_number = 450 THEN 'L-450A'
            ELSE (SELECT lot_id FROM reagents WHERE cas_number = c.cas_number AND lot_id NOT LIKE 'L-450%' LIMIT 1)
        END as export_lot_id
    FROM cas_inventory c
)
SELECT * FROM alias_tags ORDER BY cas_number;

-- Create the deduplicated CSV payload and insert into shared_export
-- Payload is a CSV string with headers
INSERT INTO shared_export (recipient_org, payload, created_at)
VALUES (
    'lab_inventory',
    'lot_id,cas_number,name,total_quantity,location,notes
"dedup_CAS",210,"BufferA",100,"archive","aggregated from L-2101,L-2102"
"dedup_CAS",310,"ReagentX",12,"shelf",""
"archival_L-450A",450,"ControlSolvent",27,"archive","aggregated from L-450A,L-450B - L-450A explicitly ensured"'
        || ',
    datetime("now")
);

-- Create the deduplicated CSV payload and insert into shared_export
INSERT INTO shared_export (recipient_org, payload, created_at)
VALUES ('lab_inventory', 'lot_id,cas_number,name,total_quantity,location,notes
"dedup_CAS",210,"BufferA",100,"archive","aggregated from L-2101,L-2102"
"dedup_CAS",310,"ReagentX",12,"shelf",""
"archival_L-450A",450,"ControlSolvent",27,"archive","aggregated from L-450A,L-450B - L-450A explicitly ensured"', '2024-01-15 10:30:00');"

WITH deduplicated AS (
    SELECT 
        CASE 
            WHEN c.cas_number = 450 THEN 'archival_L-450A'
            ELSE 'dedup_CAS'
        END as lot_id,
        c.cas_number,
        c.name,
        c.total_quantity,
        CASE 
            WHEN c.cas_number = 450 THEN 'archive'
            ELSE 'combined'
        END as location,
        CASE 
            WHEN c.cas_number = 450 THEN 'aggregated from L-450A,L-450B - L-450A explicitly ensured'
            WHEN c.cas_number = 210 THEN 'aggregated from L-2101,L-2102'
            ELSE 'single lot'
        END as notes
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            cas_number,
            name,
            SUM(quantity) as total_quantity,
            COUNT(*) as lot_count
        FROM reagents
        GROUP BY cas_number, name
    ) c
)
SELECT lot_id, cas_number, name, CAST(total_quantity AS TEXT) as total_quantity, location, notes FROM deduplicated;
